data.reason: Fixes an IndexOutOfRangeException on metadata symbols (types from referenced assemblies with no syntax), but now passes null to Diagnostic.Create if DeclaringSyntaxReferences is empty, which may silently suppress a needed diagnostic instead of gracefully handling the error case.
